newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates steady on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates steady on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were mostly steady on Friday in thin activity on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus none on Thursday.
- Two barges, next week, Mid-Mississippi, bid 160 percent of tariff, no offer.
- Two barges, week of September 29, Mid-Mississippi, bid 175 percent, no offer.
- Four barges, one each week of October, Mid-Mississippi, bid 215 percent, no offer.
